title: Decide whether to mask secret-looking flag values in check command lines sent to Engram
outcome: From tm-winf round-12 review (Claude, Note). The normalised command line goes to Engram verbatim in the verification summary's first line and the command: ref, so --token=... style values reach Engram's store unless its redactor refuses the report (then the fallback observation-only report is sent). Documented; logs already avoid the command line. Masking --*token*=, --*key*=, --password= values before sending would change the check fingerprint an author pins (--bind N=test:FINGERPRINT), so it is a contract decision (mask only in summary/refs and keep the fingerprint over the unmasked line?).
